capabilities: Create siblings and children with Enter/Tab keyboard workflow
Reparent nodes by dragging them onto other nodes with cycle prevention
Collapse and expand complete descendant trees from parent nodes
Automatically lay out branches with contour-based left, right, and balanced placement
Search, rename, and reorganize roots from a synchronized map outline
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or newer; some Canvas interactions rely on undocumented runtime APIs. The plugin had not yet been accepted into the community directory when the README was written, so manual installation steps are included. Runs locally with no network requests or telemetry.
intentEvidence: A dedicated mind-mapping experience inside Obsidian Canvas.
motivation: The author wanted to reproduce dedicated mind-mapping software workflows inside Canvas, extending the Mindvas foundation with drag-to-reparent, persistent collapsing, hotkeys, and an expanded outline.
problem: Canvas lacks the interactions people expect from standalone mind-mapping software, such as Enter/Tab branching, collapsing subtrees, and dropping nodes to reparent branches.

relations.evidence: It is based on the MIT-licensed Mindvas project by mobench and retains its original copyright

summary: Mind-mapping mode for Obsidian Canvas with keyboard branching, drag-to-reparent, collapsible trees, automatic layout, and a synchronized outline.
